description: This Java source file defines the `ThingSearchMappingStrategies` class, which extends `MappingStrategies`. It sets up various mapping strategies used by the Thing Search service within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including singleton instantiation and composition of other strategies like policies, things, streamed snapshot, and global mapping strategies.
